_comment: DOOM_Ants has no version-bearing source file. The version lives only as the git tag (v<X.Y.Z>) and the CHANGELOG heading. The single release entrypoint is packaging/release.sh, which runs the tests, builds the Linux AppImage + Windows zip, promotes the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section, tags, pushes, and publishes the GitHub release with both artifacts attached. Prefer it over the generic /release skill's own build/commit/tag steps. For a single-OS rebuild, packaging/linux-build.sh or packaging/windows-build.sh build one artifact each.
post_check: test -x packaging/release.sh && echo 'OK: packaging/release.sh is the single release entrypoint; no source file stores the version'
todos: Make sure CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] holds the {NEW} changes — release.sh promotes it to `## [{NEW}] - {TODAY}` automatically on --publish.
